description: Prayer times (imsak, fajr, sunrise, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha, midnight) for a town, city or coordinates, in local time, for one day or a timetable of up to 31 days. Covers 34,000 towns worldwide (names in English or Arabic). Calculation method defaults to the usual one for the country (Umm al-Qura in Saudi Arabia, Egyptian in Egypt, Karachi in Pakistan, ISNA in North America, MWL elsewhere) and is always stated; asr standard or hanafi.

asr.description: Asr juristic method; default standard (hanafi in PK, IN, BD, AF).

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name to pick among same-named towns.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today in the place's timezone.

days.description: Number of days from date (timetable). Default 1.

place.description: Town or city name, optionally with country: "Riyadh", "Birmingham, UK", "القاهرة". Or use latitude/longitude.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for coordinates, e.g. "Europe/London". Default: from the nearest town.

name: prayer_times
title: Islamic prayer times
